triage.rlsNoPolicy: Intentional deny-first: inactive financial/message tables and private security/audit records have no ordinary policy. Not a bypass.
triage.authenticatedDefiner: 17 explicit reviewed authenticated RPCs use live actor/clinic authority and empty search_path. Their intentional EXECUTE alone is not an exploit; actual ordinary-JWT negative proofs are separate.
triage.leakedPasswordProtection: NOT VERIFIED for release: provider reports protection disabled. Requires authorized dashboard configuration/provider entitlement plus actual weak/compromised-password denial tests.
